title: RadioConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the RibbonUI radio atom.

id.description: Stable radio instance identifier; also the native input DOM id.

label.description: Visible text that also supplies the radio accessible name.

value.description: Form value submitted when this radio is the selected option in its group.

checked.description: Controlled checked state rendered by the native input; the host owns the value.

name.description: Shared form field name that groups radios natively.

disabled.description: Whether native activation and focus participation are disabled.

required.description: Whether the group must have a selection for native form submission.
